name: timi-cloud-functions
description: 王者荣耀英雄方案小程序云函数集合

scripts.install:all: npm run install:createPlan && npm run install:deletePlan && npm run install:getAllPlans && npm run install:getHeroPlans && npm run install:getHeroSkills && npm run install:getPlanDetail && npm run install:getRecommendPlans && npm run install:getUserFavorites && npm run install:getUserInfo && npm run install:getUserPlans && npm run install:msgSecCheck && npm run install:toggleFavorite && npm run install:toggleLike && npm run install:updatePlan && npm run install:updatePlanStatus
scripts.deploy:all: echo '请在微信开发者工具中右键云函数选择上传部署'
scripts.update:wx-server-sdk: echo '更新所有云函数的wx-server-sdk版本...' && node ../scripts/update-cloud-deps.js
scripts.check:versions: echo '检查云函数依赖版本一致性...' && node ../scripts/check-versions.js
